background.description: Choose where the character is placed: for example, a studio, garden or city street. Background treatment below controls how that setting is shown.

scene_detail.label: Background treatment

options.label: Soft focus

options.label: Minimal

scene_detail.description: Control how the surroundings appear behind the character: blurred, clearly detailed, or kept simple and uncluttered. The chosen location stays the same.

soft.description: Blur the background gently while keeping the character as the main focus. The location can still be recognizable, but small background details are softened.

sharp.description: Keep background details clear and recognizable, so the setting matters alongside the character. Use this when you want to see buildings, foliage or room details.

minimal.description: Keep the surroundings simple, with few distractions and plenty of empty space. This reduces clutter; it does not specifically ask for blur or remove the chosen location.

framing.description: Choose how much of the character fits inside the image, from head and shoulders to the full body. This controls the crop.

full_body.description: Show the whole character, including the shoes, with space above the head and below the feet.

three_quarter.description: Show the character from the head to just below the knees. The feet and shoes are outside the image.

waist_up.description: Show the head and upper body down to the waist. Lower garments and shoes are left out of the prompt, and poses are described through the visible upper body.

portrait.description: Show only the head and shoulders. Best for face details; lower-body clothing, shoes and bust-fit descriptions are left out of the prompt.

lighting.description: Choose the direction, softness and color of the light falling on the character and scene.

softbox.description: Soft studio light from the upper left, with gentle shadows to the right. Good for an evenly readable character portrait.

daylight.description: Natural outdoor daylight. The prompt describes the selected daylight setup without changing the background location.

golden.description: Warm, low sunlight from the right, like late afternoon. Casts longer, softer shadows to the left.

overcast.description: Cloudy-sky daylight spread broadly across the scene, with soft shadows and low contrast.

rim.description: A narrow light outlines the edges of the hair and shoulders, helping separate the character from the background.

window.description: Soft light enters from the left, like light through a window, fading gently into shadow.

neon.description: Colored light from two sides: cyan on the left and magenta on the right.

candle.description: Warm candlelight with softly fading shadows, for an intimate low-light mood.

composition.label: Composition

options.label: Balanced
options.phrase: balanced spacing, a restrained palette and a calm mood

options.label: Editorial
options.phrase: asymmetric negative space, coordinated colors and a composed editorial mood

options.label: Dramatic
options.phrase: strong visual contrast, a focused palette and a dramatic mood

options.label: Dynamic
options.phrase: diagonal visual flow, vivid color accents and an energetic, dynamic mood

composition.description: Guide how the image is arranged and how it feels: visual spacing, use of empty space, color palette and mood. Framing controls how much of the body is shown.

balanced.description: Spread visual weight evenly around the character, with restrained colors and a calm mood. A useful starting point for a straightforward character portrait.

editorial.description: Leave more empty space on one side of the character, like a composed magazine photograph. Uses coordinated colors and a polished, deliberate mood.

dramatic.description: Ask for stronger visual contrast, a focused set of colors and a more intense mood. Lighting is still chosen separately.

dynamic.description: Use diagonal visual flow and vivid color accents to create energy and movement in the composition. Pose and lighting remain separate choices.

default.label: Original material
default.description: Keep the material already described by the selected garment.

cotton.label: Cotton
cotton.description: A familiar fabric with a soft, mostly matte appearance, like a T-shirt or everyday shirt.

linen.label: Linen
linen.description: A lightly textured fabric that often shows natural creases, like a relaxed summer shirt.

silk.label: Silk
silk.description: A fine fabric that drapes softly and often catches light with a gentle sheen.

wool.label: Wool
wool.description: A warm-looking fabric, often used for sweaters, tailored jackets and coats.

denim.label: Denim
denim.description: The sturdy fabric used for jeans, with a visible diagonal weave.

leather.label: Leather
leather.description: A solid hide-like surface that can look smooth, firm or slightly glossy.

suede.label: Suede
suede.description: A leather surface with a soft, fuzzy finish and little shine.

velvet.label: Velvet
velvet.description: A plush surface with short, dense fibers that catch light in soft highlights.

satin.label: Satin
satin.description: A smooth fabric surface with a noticeable sheen, often used for evening wear.

jersey.label: Jersey
jersey.description: A soft, flexible knit fabric, like the material of many T-shirts.

corduroy.label: Corduroy
corduroy.description: A fabric with rows of raised ridges, often used for trousers and jackets.

canvas.label: Canvas
canvas.description: A sturdy, closely woven fabric, often used for workwear and casual shoes.

crepe.label: Crepe
crepe.description: A fabric with a fine, slightly pebbled or crinkled surface.

chiffon.label: Lined chiffon
chiffon.description: A light, delicate fabric over an opaque lining, so the garment remains covered.

brocade.label: Brocade
brocade.description: A decorative fabric with raised-looking designs woven into it, often used for ornate or formal clothing.

default.label: Original surface
default.description: Keep the selected garment’s original surface description.

smooth.label: Smooth
smooth.description: An even, matte surface without a strongly visible texture.

ribbed.label: Ribbed knit
ribbed.description: Fine raised rows in the knit, like the ribs on a sweater cuff.

cable.label: Cable knit
cable.description: Raised, rope-like knitted patterns, like those on a cable-knit sweater.

twill.label: Twill
twill.description: A weave with small diagonal lines across the fabric, as seen in denim or chinos.

jacquard.label: Jacquard
jacquard.description: A decorative pattern woven into the fabric itself, rather than printed on top.

quilted.label: Quilted
quilted.description: A padded surface divided by stitching into diamond-shaped sections.

pleated.label: Pleated
pleated.description: Regular folds pressed into the fabric, like those on a pleated skirt.

brushed.label: Brushed
brushed.description: A softly fuzzy surface, like brushed flannel.

crinkled.label: Crinkled
crinkled.description: Small, irregular wrinkles that give the fabric a relaxed, uneven surface.

herringbone.label: Herringbone
herringbone.description: A repeating zigzag weave that looks like rows of small V shapes.

seersucker.label: Seersucker
seersucker.description: Alternating smooth and puckered areas that give the fabric a lightly rippled surface.

piping.label: Contrast piping
piping.description: A narrow, cord-like edge along seams, often in a contrasting color to outline the garment’s shape.

embroidery.label: Embroidery
embroidery.description: Decorative designs stitched into the fabric with thread. This option asks for a floral design in your chosen accent color.

buttons.label: Buttons
buttons.description: Visible buttons in the chosen accent color, such as those down the front of a shirt or jacket.

stitching.label: Topstitching
stitching.description: Visible lines of stitching on the outside of the garment, often following seams or pocket edges.

trim.label: Edge trim
trim.description: A decorative border along the garment’s edges, such as its neckline, cuffs or hem.

belt.label: Belt
belt.description: A band around the waist, in the chosen accent color, to secure or define the outfit.

pockets.label: Patch pockets
pockets.description: Pockets made from separate pieces of fabric sewn onto the outside of the garment.

stripes.label: Stripes
stripes.description: Narrow, repeated lines across the fabric in the chosen accent color.

checks.label: Checks
checks.description: A repeated grid of crossing lines or squares, like a checked shirt.

laces.label: Laces
laces.description: The cords threaded through a shoe or boot to fasten it. Choose their color separately from the footwear.

buckle.label: Buckle
buckle.description: The fastening piece on a belt, shoe or strap. Choose its accent color separately.

ribbon.label: Ribbon
ribbon.description: A narrow decorative band, such as the band around a hat, in the chosen accent color.

applique.label: Applique
applique.description: Decorative shapes made from pieces of material attached to the garment. This option asks for geometric shapes in your chosen accent color.

ethnicity.label: Ethnicity / heritage
ethnicity.description: Browse by region and select an ethnicity or cultural origin. Expand a region to see its choices; the section containing your selection stays open. Skin color, hair and clothing remain independent. Unspecified adds no ethnicity description.
